The '''Winagrew system''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the [[Graador sector/Legends|Graador sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] at [[Galactic coordinates/Legends|Galactic coordinates]] J-17.<ref name="Atlas Companion" /> Around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] leader [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was supposed to visit the system on a diplomatic mission, but was [[Battle of the Sixela system|captured]] by rogue [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]] before she could arrive.<ref name="Uprising">''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Winagrew system received a mention in [[Alex Wheeler]]'s [[2010]] novel ''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''.
